title: Recording, mixing: Mind Train, Midsummer New York, Don’t Count The Waves by Yoko Ono | 1971
content:
Studio A, Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Yoko Ono worked on three songs for her second album Fly on 24 August 1971.

The bulk of the recording session was devoted to ‘Mind Train’. It featured Ono on vocals, John Lennon on electric guitar, Klaus Voormann on bass guitar, and Jim Keltner on drums.

Lennon also added a dobro overdub to ‘Midsummer New York’, which had been recorded the previous day, and Voormann and Keltner overdubbed percussion to ‘Don’t Count The Waves’.

Towards the end of the session, mixes were made of all three recordings.
